title: Overhaul fill_blank.py grader with grading table, JSON output, and calibration
acceptance_criteria: AI grading mode auto-maps each blank to a sub-question with label='Blank N', score=1.0, strictness='Normal', reference=accepted answers string
When grading_table is provided: uses it directly (overrides auto-mapping); each row corresponds to a sub-question

New system prompt instructs the LLM to return a JSON object with an array of sub-question results, each containing: label, raw_score (0 to sub-question max), max_score, reasoning (<=200 chars), feedback (<=300 chars)
User prompt includes: question description (truncated to 2000 chars), rubric, grading_table/auto-mapped sub-questions, and student answers per blank (each truncated to 1000 chars)
LLM call uses profile='grading' with chat() helper
Response JSON is parsed; falls back to exact matching on parse failure (existing _grade_exact as fallback)
Each sub-question score is calibrated via calibrate_score(raw_score, sub_max, strictness)
Per-sub-question SubmissionTestCase rows are created with: case=N, status=AC/WA, points=calibrated_score, total=sub_max, feedback=LLM feedback, extended_feedback=LLM reasoning
When grading_table is None AND grading_mode is 'ai': uses auto-mapping from blanks (backward compatible)
Exact matching path (_grade_exact) continues to work unchanged for grading_mode='exact'
Implements retry logic: HTTP 429/500/502/503/504 → exponential backoff (1s, 5s, 25s), max 3 retries
